# stiXplainer Workspace Instructions

Read `AGENTS.md`, `config/production_profile.toml`, `docs/default-production-profile.md` and `docs/visual-style-bible.md` before production changes. Use the Studio Director and eight profiles in `.github/agents/` when the host supports subagents; otherwise work sequentially and do not claim parallel agents ran. Keep the ₹0 constraint absolute. Use original expressive hand-drawn stickmen, illustrated environments, diagrams and purposeful motion. Treat the uploaded silent clip as visual inspiration only; do not copy or commit its frames/artwork. Source factual claims, separate narration from visual direction, and keep subtitles synchronized. Ask before major style/mascot changes, unclear asset rights, spending or public release. Never claim a render exists without inspecting the file.
